name: Steal A Monke OG
summary:
🦍 Welcome to Steal a Monke OG  - Steal a Brainrot in VR 🦍

You like to steal. You really, REALLY like to steal. Buy and steal brainrots to earn big money! Rebirth and unlock crazy rewards to troll other players! Stay tuned for weekly updates!

🤪 How to Play

    Buy a brainrot 🥤🥷
    Steal brainrots from other players 🐊✈️
    Generate money 🐘🌵
    Rebirth for rewards 🐸🛞
    Buy slaps and items to troll other players 🦈👟

Remember, other players will try to steal from you too! 🥊
